author: Inside Edition
description: One grandmother says she received a message saying her bank account was compromised and provided a phone number to call urgently. The grandma says one caller told her she needed to withdraw $25,000 but not to tell the bank because the caller said the hacking could be an inside job. The 75-year-old took out the money but says things got weirder. The grandmother turned detective enlisted her neighbors' help. The police got involved and enlisted the grandmother to be part of a sting.
title: Grandma Outsmarts Scammers

author: Inside Edition
description: It was a heart-stopping moment on the streets of Turkey, when a motorbike ran straight into a father who was pushing his child in a stroller. Surveillance video from a nearby business caught the incident. The father seems to have a difficult time crossing the street and comes to a stop for passing vehicles. It's unclear if the bike rider didn't see them or couldn't maneuver out of their path in time to avoid a collision. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Father And Baby Injured When Motorbike Collides With Dad Pushing Stroller

author: Inside Edition
description: Bill and Allison Cosens say they got a phone call saying their missing 11-year-old beagle-mix had been found.
title: Scammer Uses AI To Try To Swindle Family Over Dog #shorts
